name: quality-tools
description: QE tooling for Claude Code, packaged as kits - one per artefact you have in your hands.

plugins.name: qe-ticket-kit
plugins.description: Assess and improve Jira tickets, and write structured bug reports.

plugins.name: qe-test-plan-kit
plugins.description: Design test plans and scenarios - functional coverage, manual test plans, and business-language Gherkin.

plugins.name: qe-test-code-kit
plugins.description: Implement automated tests - step definitions, component tests, and fixtures.

plugins.name: qe-pr-kit
plugins.description: Decide how much review a PR needs, assess risk, and open PRs to convention.

plugins.name: qe-service-kit
plugins.description: Map and document services - architecture, contracts, and catalog compliance.
